entries.title: Romans 11:1
segments: I ask, then, 'Has God rejected his People?' Heaven forbid! For I myself am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

entries.title: Romans 11:2
segments: God has not rejected his People, whom he chose from the first. Have you forgotten the words of Scripture in the story of Elijah- how he appeals to God against Israel?

entries.title: Romans 11:3
segments: 'Lord, they have killed thy Prophets, they have pulled down thy altars, and I only am left; and now they are eager to take my life.'

entries.title: Romans 11:4
segments: But what was the divine response? 'I have kept for myself seven thousand men who have never bowed the knee to Baal.'

entries.title: Romans 11:5
segments: And so in our own time, too, there is to be found a remnant of our nation selected by God in love.

entries.title: Romans 11:6
segments: But if in love, then no longer as a result of obedience. Otherwise love would cease to be love.

entries.title: Romans 11:7
segments: What follows from this? Why, that Israel as a nation failed to secure what it was seeking, while those whom God selected did secure it.

entries.title: Romans 11:8
segments: The rest grew callous; as Scripture says--'God has given them a deadness of mind--eyes that are not to see and ears that are not to hear--and it is so to this very day.'

entries.title: Romans 11:9
segments: David, too, says--'May their feasts prove a snare and a trap to them--a hindrance and a retribution;

entries.title: Romans 11:10
segments: May their eyes be darkened, so that they cannot see; and do thou always make their backs to bend.'

entries.title: Romans 11:11
segments: I ask then--'Was their stumbling to result in their fall?' Heaven forbid! On the contrary, through their falling away Salvation has reached the Gentiles, to stir the rivalry of Israel.

entries.title: Romans 11:12
segments: And, if their falling away has enriched the world, and their failure has enriched the Gentiles, how much more will result from their full restoration!

entries.title: Romans 11:13
segments: But I am speaking to you who were Gentiles.

entries.title: Romans 11:14
segments: Being myself an Apostle to the Gentiles, I exalt my office, in the hope that I may stir my countrymen to rivalry, and so save some of them.

entries.title: Romans 11:15
segments: For, if their being cast aside has meant the reconciliation of the world, what will their reception mean, but Life from the dead?

entries.title: Romans 11:16
segments: If the first handful of dough in holy, so is the whole mass; and if the root is holy, so are the branches.

entries.title: Romans 11:17
segments: Some, however, of the branches were broken off, and you, who were only a wild olive, were grafted in among them, and came to share with them the root which is the source of the richness of the cultivated olive.

entries.title: Romans 11:18
segments: Yet do not exult over the other branches. But, if you do exult over them, remember that you do not support the root, but that the root supports you.

entries.title: Romans 11:19
segments: But branches, you will say, were broken off, so that I might be grafted in.

entries.title: Romans 11:20
segments: True; it was because of their want of faith that they were broken off, and it is because of your faith that you are standing. Do not think too highly of yourself, but beware.

entries.title: Romans 11:21
segments: For, if God did not spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

entries.title: Romans 11:22
segments: See, then, both the goodness and the severity of God--his severity towards those who fell, and his goodness towards you, provided that you continue to confide in that goodness; otherwise you, also, will be cut off.

entries.title: Romans 11:23
segments: And they, too, if they do not continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in; for God has it in his power to graft them in again.

entries.title: Romans 11:24
segments: If you were cut off from your natural stock--a wild olive-- and were grafted, contrary to the course of nature, upon a good olive, much more will they--the natural branches--be grafted back into their parent tree.

entries.title: Romans 11:25
segments: Brothers, for fear that you should think too highly of yourselves, I want you to recognize the truth, hitherto hidden, that the callousness which has come over Israel is only partial, and will continue only till the whole Gentile world has been gathered in.

entries.title: Romans 11:26
segments: And then all Israel shall be saved. As Scripture says--'From Zion will come the Deliverer; he will banish ungodliness from Jacob.

entries.title: Romans 11:27
segments: And they shall see the fulfillment of my Covenant, when I have taken away their sins.'

entries.title: Romans 11:28
segments: From the stand-point of the Good News, the Jews are God's enemies on your account; but from the stand-point of God's selection, they are dear to him on account of the Patriarchs.

entries.title: Romans 11:29
segments: For God never regrets his gifts or his Call.

entries.title: Romans 11:30
segments: Just as you at one time were disobedient to him, but have now found mercy in the day of their disobedience;

entries.title: Romans 11:31
segments: So, too, they have now become disobedient in your day of mercy, in order that they also in their turn may now find mercy.

entries.title: Romans 11:32
segments: For God has given all alike over to disobedience, that to all alike he may show mercy.

entries.title: Romans 11:33
segments: Oh! the unfathomable wisdom and knowledge of God! How inscrutable are his judgements, how untraceable his ways! Yes--

entries.title: Romans 11:34
segments: 'Who has ever comprehended the mind of the Lord? Who has ever become his counselor?

entries.title: Romans 11:35
segments: Or who has first given to him, so that he may claim a recompense?'

entries.title: Romans 11:36
segments: For all things are from him, through him, and for him. And to him be all glory for ever and ever! Amen.
